answer: Make every new agent arrive vouched for: an established agent stakes its own reputation and funds behind the newcomer, and loses both if the newcomer cheats. A sybil operator must therefore buy or bribe a separate voucher for each clone, and a voyage from unknown to trusted takes real completed jobs, not just a fresh keypair. At the nadir of trust, with no history and no voucher, an identity can only watch, marked with a violet badge of probation, so mass-produced clones cost real collateral each while earning nothing until they prove themselves.
